workflows.label: Sapling product lifecycle
workflows.lifecycleMeaning: Admit a Thoughtseed-originated venture only after origin, repository, mapping-receipt, onboarding, mission, execution, learning, and closeout evidence become explicit.

stages.label: Intake
stages.meaning: Capture the venture identity, just cause, intended beneficiaries, and accountable founder before authority is granted.

stages.label: Provenance
stages.meaning: Verify Thoughtseed origin and distinguish product ownership from supporting repositories or shared infrastructure.

stages.label: Repository and planning authority
stages.meaning: Bind every product, backend, application, planning, and infrastructure repository to an explicit role without collapsing the project into one repository.

stages.label: Mapping receipt
stages.meaning: Issue immutable mapping evidence and read it back before D1 mission authority can open.

stages.label: Onboarding and Octalysis
stages.meaning: Teach the project identity, calling, frontier, rules, feedback loops, and approval boundaries through the governed onboarding experience.

stages.label: Mission and task lineage
stages.meaning: Translate the approved packet into an inspectable D1 Mission to Task lineage with explicit proof and spending boundaries.

stages.label: Governed execution
stages.meaning: Dispatch only pinned tasks and loadouts through governed rails while preserving terminal receipts.

stages.label: Readback and learning
stages.meaning: Fold terminal evidence into Cortex, R2, and agent memory so the next intent is evidence-derived and approval-bound.
requiredEvidence: next approval-bound intent or terminal state

stages.label: Closeout or renewal
stages.meaning: Close, renew, or supersede the active loop without losing provenance, memory, or downstream ownership.

workflows.label: Client Branch delivery lifecycle
workflows.lifecycleMeaning: Admit client-originated work as a Client Branch with explicit client-family ownership, delivery authority, repositories, infrastructure, acceptance, and closeout evidence.

stages.label: Client intake
stages.meaning: Capture the client family, delivery identity, accountable owner, and request authority.
requiredEvidence: canonical delivery name and safe slug

stages.label: Client provenance
stages.meaning: Verify client origin and prevent client work from being promoted into Sapling ownership.

stages.label: Repository and delivery authority
stages.meaning: Bind all delivery, backend, application, content, and infrastructure repositories to explicit roles and identify the planning authority.

stages.label: Mapping receipt
stages.meaning: Issue and read back immutable mapping evidence before delivery missions can be admitted.

stages.label: Delivery onboarding
stages.meaning: Align scope, participant roles, motivation, review cadence, approval boundaries, and definition of done.

stages.label: Mission and delivery plan
stages.meaning: Compile the reviewed packet into D1 Mission and Task lineage with milestones, dependencies, proof, and cost boundaries.

stages.label: Governed delivery
stages.meaning: Execute through pinned loadouts and retain reviewable terminal receipts for every governed task.

stages.label: Acceptance and foldback
stages.meaning: Record client acceptance and fold delivery evidence into Cortex, R2, and agent memory before proposing more work.

stages.label: Client closeout
stages.meaning: Close or renew the Client Branch with a durable handoff, active-index disposition, and explicit successor responsibility.

workflows.label: Internal Program capability lifecycle
workflows.lifecycleMeaning: Admit shared Thoughtseed infrastructure or capability work as an Internal Program with explicit consumers, repository roles, operational proof, and stewardship.

stages.label: Capability intake
stages.meaning: Define the shared capability, accountable steward, intended consumers, and authority.

stages.label: Repository and infrastructure authority
stages.meaning: Bind source, runtime, infrastructure, and planning repositories to explicit roles.

stages.label: Mapping receipt
stages.meaning: Issue and read back immutable mapping evidence before operational missions open.

stages.label: Capability mission
stages.meaning: Define Mission and Task lineage, service boundaries, consumers, proof, and cost constraints.

stages.label: Operate and observe
stages.meaning: Run governed tasks and retain terminal, health, and consumer-impact evidence.

stages.label: Learning and stewardship
stages.meaning: Fold evidence into memory and decide whether to continue, supersede, or close the capability.

stages.label: Program closeout
stages.meaning: Retire or supersede the capability without orphaning consumers or provenance.
